notes: r1 (2026-11-01): Forza Horizon 6's native route. Wine 11.18 with patches-arm64 through 0052, FEX 2610 with fex/patches through 0033, vkd3d-proton with renderers-arm64 through 0010, and KosmicKrisp (Mesa's Vulkan driver on Metal 4) with steamac's patches and kosmickrisp-arm64/highball in place of MoltenVK. A line of its own: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024's engine and its offers do not move until a flight has run on these patches.

The Khronos loader is engine/lib/libMoltenVK.dylib, the name winevulkan opens, and VK_DRIVER_FILES points it at the driver in renderers/kosmickrisp. Steam's browser runs without Chromium's sandbox (appDefaults): with the game's emulator switches its renderer dies at once inside the sandbox and is relaunched for good, so the sign-in window never comes (measured 2026-11-01).
Known: a burst of stalls of several seconds in all, about half a minute into the first drive of a session on a warm shader cache, cause open. Measured only on a base M4 with 32 GB.

wine.version: wine-11.18 (WineHQ) Highball arm64 build 2026-11-01, patches-arm64 through 0052, FEX 2610 with fex/patches through 0033, Wine Mono 11.3.0 and Gecko 2.47.4 included
wine.note: Built from WineHQ's wine-11.18.tar.xz by highball-engine's build-arm64 workflow (run 41251324676, branch fh6-native 9f4381b).

frameworks.license: mixed (LGPL-2.1 GStreamer 1.28.7 and its plugins, Apache-2.0 MoltenVK inside the GStreamer framework)
frameworks.version: GStreamer 1.28.7 (the official macOS framework, pruned to the plugins winegstreamer uses, with applemedia for VideoToolbox decoding, thinned to arm64)
frameworks.note: The same archive as the wine component, its frameworks folder; the store downloads it once.

vulkan.note: The name Wine's winevulkan opens on this line, replacing the engine's own MoltenVK (so it installs after the wine component). VK_DRIVER_FILES in baseEnv points it at KosmicKrisp. build-kosmickrisp-arm64 run 41250881744.

kosmickrisp.version: Mesa at ce576c29 with steamac's 49 KosmicKrisp patches and kosmickrisp-arm64/highball 0001-0006
kosmickrisp.note: The same archive as the vulkan component; its licences and NOTICE are inside.

renderers.version: vkd3d-proton and DXVK, ARM64EC builds with renderers-arm64 through vkd3d-proton 0010, dxvk 0003, dxil-spirv 0001

verified.result: The archives of these runs on a Mac mini M4 with 32 GB, installed by the app's own store, with the signed loader. Forza Horizon 6 through steam -applaunch: 30.2 fps, 7554 of 7713 frames at 2 vsyncs over 255 s of Auto Drive at 1080p, Very Low, FSR Quality, cap 30. A new environment made by the app from Play, game cloned, Steam's sign-in window drawn. No other Mac tested, and no sign-in carried out in a fresh environment.
